note: No AI features. Every server function except getAuthStatus carries authMiddleware and scopes queries by user_id. The cron routes use a constant-time bearer check. Tesla tokens are AES-GCM encrypted at rest. Every table has RLS enabled with no policies, so the anon key gets nothing, and all data access is server-side Drizzle on a direct connection that bypasses RLS. Tenant isolation is the user_id predicate in each query. Every Drizzle query and every raw db.execute query checked carries it, so no database_rules label. Only VITE_SUPABASE_URL and the anon key reach the browser. No committed secrets were found. localStorage holds only theme, units, accent and date range. The Tesla public key .pem file was blocked by a permission rule.

labels.what: Any Supabase user passes the middleware. The single-user design depends on a manual Supabase setting to turn off sign-ups (README step 2). The anon key ships to the browser, so if that setting stays on, anyone can sign up, link a Tesla, and the cron polls their car on the owner's Fleet API credit and Mapbox token. No email or user id allowlist in code
VITE_SUPABASE_URL and VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY ship to the browser for Supabase Auth sign-in. The anon key is public by design. All tables deny it through RLS with no policies

Vehicle upsert on VIN conflict sets user_id to the current user. Another account that can see the same VIN (shared driver, resold car) takes over the vehicle row from the first owner. Same pattern in resyncTesla
Raw database and Tesla API error text (dbErrorMessage, token endpoint body) is returned to the browser in resyncTesla, getAuthStatus (line 37) and the tesla_error redirect query string
MQTT broker allows anonymous clients. Safe only while docker-compose keeps port 1883 unpublished. Publishing the port lets anyone inject telemetry for known VINs
fleet-telemetry uses the unpinned :latest image and runs as root (user 0:0) while exposed publicly on port 443

One owner's real charging receipts, VIN and home charger geofence name are committed as the default importer input. The importer also hardcodes the default path, a UTC+8 offset (line 65) and MYR currency fallback (line 84)
PACK_KWH = 75 used as the battery size fallback when the vehicle has no pack_kwh set
MIN_CHARGE_KWH is 3 in anomaly.ts and 5 in battery.functions.ts. Same name, two values, for the minimum charge size to trust
RECONCILE_CRON '0 * * * *' must match the cron string in wrangler.jsonc. If the deploy config changes, reconcile silently stops and that tick runs the poll cycle
DEFAULT_PROXY = https://localhost:4443 for the signing proxy (overridable by --proxy)
